scripts.verify: pnpm lint:fast && pnpm typecheck && pnpm transpile:electron && pnpm test
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run transpile:electron && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run transpile:electron && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run transpile:electron && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64

scripts-info.dev: Vite dev server and Electron together - the usual way to run
scripts-info.dev:react: Vite dev server alone, no Electron window
scripts-info.dev:electron: Electron alone, against an already-running dev server
scripts-info.verify: The full pre-push gate: lint, typecheck, Electron build, tests
scripts-info.test:watch: Vitest in watch mode, re-running on change
scripts-info.test:coverage: Vitest with a V8 coverage report
scripts-info.typecheck: Typecheck the renderer and config projects (tsc -b)
scripts-info.lint:fix: ESLint over the whole repo, applying autofixes
scripts-info.lint:fast: ESLint using the on-disk cache - the one verify runs
scripts-info.build:engine: Compile the velocity Rust engine (napi release, Windows x64)
scripts-info.engine:all: Every native engine check in one run, with a pass/fail summary
scripts-info.engine:cuts: Cuts shorten the edit, playhead lands right - no hardware
scripts-info.engine:pipeline: Record the screen, then open it in the engine, no demux pass
scripts-info.engine:check: Decode, seek, render, export headlessly - needs an mp4 arg
scripts-info.engine:composition: Desktop, webcam and cursor composited - needs a camera
scripts-info.engine:export-composition: Export carries the layers the preview draws - needs a camera
scripts-info.engine:audio: An export comes out with audible sound - needs system audio
scripts-info.check:export-options: Export options survive the renderer-to-napi trip intact
scripts-info.check:layout: Main process and renderer agree on the webcam box size
scripts-info.check:phone-camera: Phone pairing server: token gate, page, frame route, SSE
scripts-info.check:phone-camera-recording: A frame posted from a phone lands in the recorded camera track
scripts-info.build: Typecheck and bundle the renderer for production
scripts-info.preview: Serve the built renderer bundle to inspect it
scripts-info.transpile:electron: Compile the Electron main and preload into dist-electron
scripts-info.rebuild:native: Rebuild better-sqlite3 and uiohook-napi against Electron's ABI
scripts-info.cleanup:db: Delete every recording row from the local SQLite database
scripts-info.prepare: Install the Husky hooks (runs automatically after install)
scripts-info.postinstall: Rebuild native modules for Electron (runs automatically)
